verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry or usage tracking is a fair question for a public-facing online service such as the department's website and Online Services account portal, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents analytics or cookie controls, a tracking opt-out, or any privacy-preference setting. The robots.txt probe only governs automated crawler access, not user telemetry, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
